text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan came to inspect the sales of 
the Machan dolls. There, she discovered 
that some people bought the mascot without 
even watching the races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if the plushie sells well, it's 
meaningless if people don't get to know 
who I am. I have to do something about 
this immediately—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An offer arrives to publish the 4-koma 
blog as a book! If people read it, they'll 
surely get to know Aston Machan much 
better!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home, Aston Machan expresses 
her gratitude. She says that thanks to her 
Trainer drawing the 4-koma manga, she 
feels like she'll be loved far into the 
distant future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And to express her gratitude, she invited 
them to share some cake together.
